$comment: sherpa-node-frame — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: a FRAME on a sherpa-layout-canvas: nodes under one header, with a title, a line and Release. Its host draws it ROUND its nodes: data-x, data-y, data-w and data-h are their box, and the frame stands clear of it, its header above. It sits behind every line and node, and only its header takes the pointer. Will, TODO 778. TRAP T-a-frame-is-drawn-round-its-nodes

props.name: data-current
props.description: the frame picked, in the look of a picked node; the HOST writes it

props.name: data-h
props.description: that box's height, in plane px

props.name: data-heading
props.description: its title, in its header (default Frame)

props.name: data-locked
props.description: the host is read only: no Release button, no grab cursor. A drag or a key still reports

props.name: data-w
props.description: that box's width, in plane px

props.name: data-x
props.description: the left of the box round its nodes, in plane px

props.name: data-y
props.description: the top of that box, in plane px

populate.shape: { current?, description?, h?, heading?, locked?, w?, x?, y? }
populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

events.name: frame-move
events.description: Its header was dragged, or an arrow key pressed there: its host moves every node in it.

events.name: frame-select
events.description: It was pressed: a click on its header, or Enter or Space there.

events.name: frame-release
events.description: Release was pressed, or Delete or Backspace on its header: its host takes the frame away, and its nodes stay.
